title: Local Roundup: Morris pitches Lehman baseball past Loyalsock - NewsBreak
text:
By Times Leader ,
3 hours ago Andrew Morris pitched a complete game with seven strikeouts as Lake-Lehman closed out its regular season with a 5-1 non-conference baseball victory Wednesday against Loyalsock Township.
Will Jenkins and Tyler Sassi each finished with two singles and an RBI. Morris and John Oliver each had an RBI. Devon Albee doubled.
Lehman (14-6) will play at home May 19 in the District 2 Class 3A quarterfinals.
Wyoming Area 18, Western Wayne 0
Alex Vacula homered, doubled and had five RBI as Wyoming Area defeated Western Wayne in five innings.
David Favata also homered and finished 3-for-5 with three RBI. Matteo Argenio doubled and had two RBI. Zach Smith also had two RBI.
Bruno Pizzano and Jacob Snyder each had a double.
Caleb Pavinski pitched four innings to pick up the win.
Crestwood 7, Berwick 1
Crestwood scored all its runs in the first inning as it defeated Berwick.
Avery Brace, Jack Rodgers, Connor Wagaman and Miles McShea all had an RBI in the inning.
Brace pitched six shutout innings, striking out five, to take the win.
Frankie Yosh had two hits for Berwick.
East Stroudsburg North 4, Hanover Area 0
The Hawkeyes were held to three hits in a non-conference loss at East Stroudsburg North.
Logan Richardson had a double while Ryan Bennett and Ben Kolbicka each had a single.
H.S. SOFTBALL
Hazleton Area 16, Wyo. Valley West 1
Isabella Boyle was 3-for-3 with a double and five RBI as Hazleton Area won in five innings.
Kayla Lagowy finished with four RBI for the Cougars, who finished the regular season at 10-10 and will likely be the third seed in the District 2/4 Class 6A playoffs.
Mikayla Barletta had a double and two RBI. Kayla Wysocky had a triple and Hannah Matyas had two RBI.
Isabella Sobieski had a triple and single for Valley West, which finished 2-15 and will be the fifth seed in the D2/4-6A playoffs. Reese McGlynn singled and had an RBI. Ella Frazier had the other RBI.
H.S. GIRLS LACROSSE
Wyoming Seminary 17, Scranton Prep 5
Ellie Kersey had seven goals as the Blue Knights coasted to a win in the quarterfinal round of the District 2 Class 2A playoffs.
Natalina DeNaples added a hat trick, while Emmy Swartz and Rachel Snyder scored two goals each.
Wyoming Seminary will head to the semifinal round on Monday, where they’ll host either Crestwood or Holy Redeemer.
Eva Kaszuba led Scranton Prep with three goals. McKenna Toolan added two goals and an assist.
H.S. BOYS VOLLEYBALL
Delaware Valley 3, Wyoming Valley West 0
The Spartans were eliminated from the District 2 Class 3A playoffs with a quarterfinal loss at Delaware Valley.
Delaware Valley will take on the top seed in Class 3A, Hazleton Area, in the second match of Tuesday’s semifinal doubleheader at Hazleton Area.
Abington Heights 3, Scranton 0
The second-seeded Comets swept away Scranton in the District 2 Class 3A quarterfinals on Wednesday night. Set scores were 25-14, 25-16 and 25-11 for Abington Heights.
Abington Heights will take on either Wilkes-Barre Area and West Scranton in the semifinal round on Tuesday at Hazleton Area.
